creator.description: Confess to me your crimes and you shall be labeled with them forthwith. I am a fair and able constable.

locales.description: This user is a murderer. They have taken the life of another outside the confines of war.
locales.name: Murderer

locales.description: This user is a thief. They have taken the property of another and made it their own.
locales.name: Thief

locales.description: This user is an arsonist. They have burned structures for profit, revenge, or a malevolent thrill.
locales.name: Arsonist

locales.description: This user is a sodomite. They take on carnal pleasures using the mouth and anus.
locales.name: Sodomite

locales.description: This user is a heretic. They hold dangerous beliefs that stand in defiance of the church and her teachings.
locales.name: Heretic

locales.description: This user is an idolator. They hold people and objects in reverence with a glory meant only for god.
locales.name: Idolator

locales.description: This user is a gambler. They have placed bets on games of chance in a dishonest effort to enrich themselves.
locales.name: Gambler

locales.description: This user has borne false witness. They have misrepresented truth for their own gain.
locales.name: Bearer of False Witness

locales.description: This user is a seducer. They have tempted men or women away from the bonds of marriage with sins of the flesh.
locales.name: Seducer

locales.description: This user is an alchemist. They have transmuted materia through unnatural and unholy means.
locales.name: Alchemist

locales.description: This user is a betrayer of kin. They have turned their back on their family and broken the bonds most unbreakable.
locales.name: Betrayer of Kin

locales.description: This user is a betrayer of country. They have acted against their neighbors and countrymen with treasonous intent.
locales.name: Betrayer of Country

locales.description: This user is a hypocrite. They betray their professed morals in private.
locales.name: Hypocrite

locales.description: This user is a horse thief. They have taken a man's means of travel, bread-winning, and often times his best friend.
locales.name: Horse Thief

locales.description: This user is a wastrel. They squander their time on frivolous and self indulgent things.
locales.name: Wastrel

locales.description: This user is a pirate. They profiteer from stolen goods, taken from honest and hardworking men of business.
locales.name: Pirate

locales.description: This user is a witch. They have cast spells in defiance of the one true God's domain.
locales.name: Witch

locales.description: This user is an embezzler. They have misappropriated funds or other assets of a company whose care and management they were trusted with.
locales.name: Embezzler

locales.description: This user is a conspirator. They have worked in secret with others to commit elaborate acts of criminality and mischief.
locales.name: Conspirator

locales.description: This user is a harborer of wanted men. They have given safe haven to known criminals and shielded them from the law.
locales.name: Harborer of Wanted Men

locales.description: This user is a vandal. They have destroyed or defaced another's property.
locales.name: Vandal

locales.description: This user is a blasphemer. They have acted in open defiance of God or encouraged others to do the same.
locales.name: Blasphemer

locales.description: This user is a urinator. They have relieved themselves outside of a chamberpot or outhouse.
locales.name: Urinator

locales.description: This user is a public fornicator. They have engaged in carnal acts in the public square, under the watch of God's eye.
locales.name: Public Fornicator

locales.description: This user is a reckless driver. They have practiced little care for the safety of others in handling their carriage through the public square.
locales.name: Reckless Driver

locales.description: This user is a cannibal. They have eaten the flesh of other men.
locales.name: Cannibal

locales.description: This user is a drunkard. They have imbibed intoxicants in the public square and made a nuisance.
locales.name: Drunkard
